v19-6.candidate: Elijah looked, and behold, at his head were a hearth cake of spelt and a flask of water. He rose, ate, and drank, then lay down again.

v20-6.candidate: He said to her, “Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite, saying, ‘Give me your vineyard for silver; or, if you wish, I will give you another vineyard in its place.’ But he said, ‘I will not give you my fathers’ inheritance.’”

v20-15.candidate: When Jezebel heard, she said to Ahab, “Rise, take possession of Naboth the Jezreelite’s vineyard, which he did not give you for silver. For Naboth is no longer alive; he is dead.”

v20-19.candidate: Say to him, ‘Thus says the Lord: Because you murdered and took possession, therefore thus says the Lord: In every place where swine and dogs licked Naboth’s blood, dogs will lick your blood there, and prostitutes will bathe in your blood.’”

v20-22.candidate: I will make your house like the house of Jeroboam son of Nebat and like the house of Baasha son of Ahijah, because of the provocations you have provoked and because you caused Israel to sin.’”

v20-12.candidate: They proclaimed a fast and seated Naboth at the head of the people.
